_comment: Single source of truth for the traffic light. Owned by Person 4 (science). build_series.py copies this into data/meta.json; the website reads meta.json and never hard-codes these.
rule: deficit_mm = et_mm - rain_mm, computed per dekad on the union-council (tehsil) mean

amber.label_en: Deficit of 1 to 30 mm; one irrigation turn covers it

red.label_en: Deficit above 30 mm; stress likely if canal water is late

nodata.label_en: No irrigated winter cereals, or a source was missing

rationale: Rabi wheat in the Peshawar valley uses about 3 to 4 mm/day in Nov-Dec, i.e. 30 to 40 mm per dekad. A single canal irrigation turn delivers roughly 30 mm (75 mm depth applied at 40% efficiency). See docs/thresholds.md.
